scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const path=require('path');const excluded=new Set(['node_modules','dist','.git','scripts','package.json','package-lock.json']);fs.rmSync('dist',{recursive:true,force:true});fs.mkdirSync('dist',{recursive:true});for(const name of fs.readdirSync('.')){if(excluded.has(name))continue;fs.cpSync(name,path.join('dist',name),{recursive:true});}console.log('Build completed: dist/');"
